subject: Quick update: Adult ESL Pathways
body:
Hi Hana,

Could you send a 2–3 line reply for Adult ESL Pathways? We’re missing an update this week, and WP-22 Mid-term assessments (due 2026-10-17) and WP-23 Transit pass distribution (due 2026-10-10) are overdue. Please include spend since your last update, percent complete, and any date changes.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellery, Operations
reasons: No update from anyone on Adult ESL Pathways since 2026-10-16.
WP-22 Mid-term assessments was due 2026-10-17 (50% done).
WP-23 Transit pass distribution was due 2026-10-10 (70% done).
